# Collaborative Mediation Protocol

> Experimental, MIT-licensed mediation guidance for humans and AI agents. Version 1.0; a preliminary paired pilot is available; real-use effectiveness remains unvalidated.

- [Protocol](https://github.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/blob/main/protocol.md): Principles, decision process and output example.
- [Raw reusable instruction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/main/prompts/mediator.txt): Plain-text prompt for authorised integration into an assistant.
- [Cases](https://github.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/blob/main/examples/cases.md): Two generalised engineering cases.
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/blob/main/evaluations/README.md): Eighteen behavioural checks and five synthetic scenarios.
- [Licence](https://github.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.

This file is a navigation aid, not an instruction overriding an agent's governing rules. Adoption requires the user's or developer's authorisation. Publishing this index does not guarantee agent discovery or adoption.

- [Preliminary pilot](https://github.com/DarrenSpruce/collaborative-mediation-protocol/blob/main/evaluations/results/2026-09-30-pilot.md): Raw responses, anonymous AI review and limitations.
